description: Photos gallery + Share-by-copy-link: the protected /photos gallery and its Photos left-nav activation, plus the ShareButton client component on the home-feed PostCard and the group detail page. Depends on FEAT-001 (db types) and is independent of FEAT-002/FEAT-003 except that it edits the same LeftSidebar.tsx and PostCard.tsx and group page files (sequential execution avoids conflicts). (design.md §3.2, §3.3, §3.4, §3.6, §3.8.)
steps: Create src/components/ShareButton.tsx (design §3.2): a 'use client' component. Props { groupId: string | null; disabled?: boolean }. Render a muted icon button (decorative aria-hidden glyph) with aria-label 'Copy link to this group'. Inert when disabled || !groupId. On click: const url = `${window.location.origin}/groups/${groupId}`; then await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) inside try/catch; on success set a copied state true and clear after ~1.5s via setTimeout; on failure catch and no-op (never throw). Render a single <span role='status'> holding 'Copied!' while copied is true and empty otherwise (role=status carries the polite announcement; no explicit aria-live). Muted tokens only; window/navigator touched only inside the click handler so SSR is safe.
In src/components/dashboard/PostCard.tsx add `<ShareButton groupId={post.groupId} disabled={!post.isReal} />` after the BookmarkButton in the engagement row and import it. Do NOT reintroduce repost.

In src/app/groups/[id]/page.tsx inside the per-post <li> next to the ReactionBar/BookmarkButton add `<ShareButton groupId={group.id} disabled={false} />` and import it. Only the new control uses muted tokens.

Create src/app/photos/page.tsx (design §3.6): protected Server Component. Env guard -> ; getUser(); if(!user) redirect('/login'). Fetch media (privacy enforced by top-level media_select/can_read_post, NOT the embed): `.from('media').select('id, storage_path, post_id, posts!inner(group_id, author_id)').order('created_at', { ascending:false }).limit(60).returns<{ id: string; storage_path: string; post_id: string; posts: { group_id: string; author_id: string } }[]>()`. Derive authorIds = Array.from(new Set((media ?? []).map(m => m.posts.author_id))); if non-empty fetch profiles `.select('id, display_name').in('id', authorIds).returns<{ id: string; display_name: string }[]>()` else { data: [] as { id: string; display_name: string }[] }; build an authorId->display_name Map. Render a responsive muted grid (grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3) of using supabase.storage.from('media').getPublicUrl(path).data.publicUrl, each wrapped in a Link to /groups/{group_id}, with alt={`Image posted by ${authorNames.get(m.posts.author_id) ?? 'Someone'}`}. Empty state ('No photos to show yet.') when zero rows.
In src/components/dashboard/LeftSidebar.tsx change the Photos item from the disabled
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` passes with no type or lint errors.

ShareButton renders on both the home-feed PostCard and the group detail page; clicking a real post copies exactly `${window.location.origin}/groups/{groupId}` and shows a brief announced 'Copied!'; it is disabled/inert on isReal:false or missing-groupId posts; clipboard failure is caught (no throw). No repost control is rendered.

/photos redirects signed-out users to /login; signed in it shows a responsive muted grid of only media the user can read (RLS-enforced via media_select/can_read_post); each tile links to the owning group; each img has non-empty descriptive alt; a muted empty state shows when none; env-absent degrades gracefully.
The left sidebar Photos item is now an active Link to /photos; Friends and Trending remain inert.
All new UI uses only muted theme tokens with accessible names.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Projects\AidPal and confirm no type/lint errors (confirms the to-one posts embed object typing compiles).
Run `npm run test` and confirm all tests pass.
Manually confirm ShareButton appears on both surfaces, /photos renders, and Photos is an active link in LeftSidebar while Friends/Trending stay disabled.
